blocks.text: Sugar Loaf and Rio city tour

provenance.rationale: Compose the assigned concise field from these verified Word passages, preserving the documented destination and service scope.

blocks.text:
After breakfast, you will head to Sugar Loaf.

The route begins at Red Beach. The cable car first takes you up Urca Hill, where you will find the first viewing platform, cafés and bars.

The second line continues to the summit of Sugar Loaf. From here, you can see Copacabana, Ipanema, Guanabara Bay, the Niterói Bridge and Corcovado with the statue of Christ the Redeemer.

After the descent, your Rio city tour begins. You will drive through the central districts and see buildings from the colonial period.

A visit to the Metropolitan Cathedral of Saint Sebastian and a stop at the colourful Selarón Steps may be possible.
